mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand, which drives positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative when both HOUST and RSAFS rise.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.0%), rising employment (PAYEMS) alongside high unemployment signals labor market stress, which triggers negative equity returns due to recessionary fears.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive when UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) reflects expanding manufacturing activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits improve.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index 2017=100), it indicates manufacturing contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: High year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain high rates and causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day returns are positive when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (yoy).

mechanism_narrative: Combined quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month averages indicate robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns are negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 12-month averages.
